custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২৫ কাটা যাবে।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১) Let her prepare the assignment. (Make it Passive)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Let the assignment prepared by her.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Let the assignment be prepare by her.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Let be her prepared the assignment.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Let the assignment be prepared by her.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Active: Let her prepare the assignment.
• Passive: Let the assignment be prepared by her.

• Let যুক্ত Imperative sentence এর Active voice কে passive voice এ পরিণত করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Let বসে।
- Object টির subject রূপে বসে।
- be বসে।
- মূল verb এর past participle form বসে।
- by বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টির Object রূপে বসে।

• Structure: Let + Object টির subject বসে + be বসে + মূল verb এর past participle form বসে + by + subject টির Object রূপে বসে।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ২) 'Nazma called me a fool.' (Make it direct)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Nazma told me, "You are a fool".
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Nazma say to me, "You are a fool".
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Nazma said to me, "You were a fool".
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Nazma said to me, "You are a fool".
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Correct answer: Nazma said to me, "You are a fool".

• Narration এর ক্ষেত্রে, 
- Indirect speech এ reported speech টি past indefinite এ হওয়ায় direct speech এ তা present indefinite এ হবে।
- Indirect speech এ called me থাকলে direct speech এ তা said to হয়।
- তারপর কমা বসবে। 
- তারপর inverted comma এর ভিতর বাকি অংশ বসে।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৩) Who will help her? (Make it passive)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: By whom will she be helped?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Active: Who will help her?
• Passive: By whom will she be helped?

• Who যুক্ত Interrogative Sentence এর Active Voice কে Passive Voice এ পরিণত করার নিয়ম:
- Who এর পরিবর্তে প্রথমে By whom বসে।
- Tense ও Person অনুযায়ী Auxiliary Verb বসাতে হয়।
- Object টি Subject হয়।
- Tense অনুযায়ী কর্তার পরে be/being/been বসাতে হয়।
- মূল Verb এর Past Participle বসে।
- সবার শেষে প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন বসে।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৪) "When I got home, I found I had lost my umbrella," Marzia said. (Make it indirect)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Marzia said that when she had got home she found that she had lost her umbrella.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Marzia said that when she got home, she found she had lost her umbrella.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Marzia said that when she had got home she found she lost her umbrella.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Marzia said that when she got home she had found that she had lost her umbrella.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Direct Speech: "When I got home, I found I had lost my umbrella," Marzia said.
• Indirect Speech: Marzia said that when she got home, she found she had lost her umbrella.

• Reported speech- এ দুয়ের অধিক verb থাকলে indirect speech করার নিয়ম:
- direct narration- এর reported speech- এ যদি দুই বা ততোধিক verb থাকে এবং সেগুলো past indefinite tense- এ থাকে।
- তাহলে, indirect speech- এ past indefinite tense এ থাকা verb গুলোর কোনো প্রকার পরিবর্তন হবে না।
- প্রশ্ন প্রদত্ত বাক্যটির direct speech- এ got, found, had lost- verb গুলো অপরিবর্তিত রয়েছে।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৫) He said to me, "Let us extend a helping hand to the flood-affected people."
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: He proposed to me that we might extend a helping hand to the flood-affected people.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: He asked me that we may extend a helping hand to the flood-affected people.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: He proposed to me that we may extend a helping hand to the flood-affected people.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: He advised me we might extend a helping hand to the flood-affected people.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Direct Speech: He said to me, "Let us extend a helping hand to the flood-affected people."
• Indirect Speech: He proposed to me that we might extend a helping hand to the flood-affected people.

- Direct Narration এ Let’s/Let us থাকলে Indirect Narration এ Propose + to + Object বসে।

অন্যভাবে বলা যায়,
- Let এর পরে us থাকলে indirect করার সময় reporting verb টি পরিবর্তিত হয়ে propose/suggest হয় + inverted comma এর পরিবর্তে that বসে + we/they + should + reported speech এর মূল verb থেকে শেষ পর্যন্ত বসে।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৬) The task cannot be done. (Make it active)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: It is impossible to be do the task.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Anyone must not do the task.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: No one can do the task.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Object ছাড়া passive voice এর বাক্যকে active করার ক্ষেত্রে সুবিধাজনক একটি subject ধরে নিয়ে করতে হয়
- এ ধরনের object বিহীন বাক্যগুলোকে acive করার সময় কাল্পনিক subject (no one, we, I, they) ব্যবহার করতে হয়।
- এরপর Let বাদ যাবে,
- be done এর active form - do বসবে।

• নিয়মানুযায়ী -
Passive: The task cannot be done.
Active: No one can do the task.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৭) I remember the cook teaching me to bake cookies. (Make it passive)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: I remember I was being teaching to bake cookies by the cook.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: I remember I was taught to bake cookies by the cook.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: I remember I was taught to be baked cookies by the cook.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: I remember being taught to bake cookies by the cook.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Voice change এর নিয়মানুযায়ী, 
-  Active Structure: Subject + like/remember/hate/mind + প্রথম object + (verb + ing) + দ্বিতীয় object + extension.
- এই গঠন যুক্ত বাক্যকে  passive এর পরিবর্তন করার নিয়ম -
- Passive Structure: Subject + like/remember/hate/mind + being + (verb + ing) এর past participle + extension + by + obj1.

• সুতরাং, নিয়মানুসারে -
Active Voice: I remember the cook teaching me to bake cookies.
Passive Voice: I remember being taught to bake cookies by the cook.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৮) Hasan said, "I must finish this homework." (Make it indirect)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Hasan said that he had to finish this homework.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Hasan said that he has to finish that homework.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Hasan said that he had to finish that homework.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Hasan said that he must finish this homework.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Narration এর ক্ষেত্রে,
• Direct speech থেকে Indirect speech এ রূপান্তরের বেলায়: 
- Reporting verb এর subject বসে। 
- Reporting verb say/said, tell/told (যদি থাকে) বসে।
- Inverted comma উঠে that বসে। 
- Direct speech এ must থাকলে Indirect speech এ had to হয়। 
- to এর পর verb এর base form বসবে। 
- বাকি অংশ বসবে।  
- Dicect speech- এ 'this' থাকলে indirect speech- এ 'that' বসবে।

Direct: Hasan said, "I must finish this homework."
Indirect: Hasan said that he had to finish that homework.

Source: A Passage to the English Language by S. M. Zakir Hussain.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৯) The Interim Government of Bangladesh ought to establish clear policies. (Make it passive)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Clear policies ought to be established by the Interim Government of Bangladesh.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Clear policies ought to been established by the Interim Government of Bangladesh.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Clear policies ought to being established by the Interim Government of Bangladesh.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Clear policies ought to be established the Interim Government of Bangladesh.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Active Voice: The Interim Government of Bangladesh ought to establish clear policies.
Passive Voice: Clear policies ought to be established by the Interim Government of Bangladesh.

• Voice এর ক্ষেত্রে,
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এর subject হয়।
- Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- তারপর মূল verb এর past participle হয়।
- Active voice এর subject টি passive voice এর object হয়।
- তার পূর্বে preposition (by, with, at, to, in) বসে।

• May, might, can, could, must, ought to, going to যুক্ত Active Voice কে Passive Voice এ পরিবর্তন করার সময় এদের পরে be বসে এবং তার পরেই মূল verb- এর Past Participle বসে। 

Structure: Object টির subject form + may/ might/can/could/must/ought to/going to + be + মূল verb- এর Past Participle + Subject- টির Object form.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১০) Change the narration: Mony said to me, "I came yesterday."
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Mony said to me that she had came the previous day.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Mony told to me that she had come the previous day.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Mony said that she had come the previous day.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Mony told me that she had come the previous day.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Direct Speech: Mony said to me, "I came yesterday."
• Indirect Speech: Mony told me that she had come the previous day.

• Narration এর ক্ষেত্রে, Direct speech থেকে Indirect speech এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম।
- Reporting verb এর subject বসে।
- Reporting verb say/said, tell/told (যদি থাকে) বসে।
- Inverted comma উঠে that বসে।
- Reported speech এর subject number/person অনুযায়ী পরিবর্তন করতে হব

• Direct speech এ said to me থাকলে indirect speech এ তা পরিবর্তিত হয়ে told হবে এবং reporting verb এর tense অনুযায়ী indirect speech এ পরিবর্তন আসবে।
- কমার বদলে that বসবে।
- reporting verb এবং reporting speech উভয়েই past indefinite থাকলে, indirect করার সময় reported speech কে past perfect tense এ রূপান্তরিত করতে হবে।
- Direct Narration - এ yesterday থাকলে Indirect Narration - এ the previous day হয়।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১১) My wallet has been stolen. (Make it active)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Someone has been stolen my wallet.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• বাক্যে ক্রিয়ার কর্তা দেয়া না থাকলে passive থেকে active করার সময় একটি সুবিধাজনক কর্তা যেমন-
someone, somebody, people, the authority ইত্যাদি ধরে নিতে হবে।
- Steal এর past participle form - stolen.
- Somebody এর সাথে has ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Passive Voice: My wallet has been stolen.
Active Voice: Someone has stolen my wallet.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১২) He said, "What a beautiful picture!"
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: He wondered that it was a beautiful picture.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: He exclaimed that it was a very beautiful picture.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: He said that what a beautiful picture it was.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: He exclaimed what a beautiful picture it was.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Direct Speech: He said, "What a beautiful picture!"
• Indirect Speech: He exclaimed that it was a very beautiful picture.

• Narration এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- Exclamatory sentence এর ক্ষেত্রে Reported speech টি How বা What দ্বারা শুরু হলে অর্থাৎ, বাক্যের শুরুতে আতিশয্য বুঝালে Indirect Narration করার সময় - - - How বা What এর পরিবর্তে Very, Much, Great ইত্যাদি ব্যবহার করতে হয়।
- said এর পরিবর্তে exclaimed ব্যবহার করতে হবে।
- এরপর কমার (,) বদলে that বসবে।
- Exclamatory Sentence টি Assertive Sentence এ রূপান্তর করতে হবে।
- বাক্যে subject না থাকায় It কে subject হিসাবে ধরে নিতে হবে। 
- reporting verb past tense থাকলে reported speech এর verb হবে  past tense এ।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৩) A perfectly ripe persimmon tastes sweet. (Make it passive)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: A perfectly ripe persimmon when is tasted sweet.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: A perfectly ripe persimmon is to being tasted sweet.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: A perfectly ripe persimmon is tasted sweet.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: A perfectly ripe persimmon as is tasted sweet.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Active: A perfectly ripe persimmon tastes sweet.
• Passive: A perfectly ripe persimmon is tasted sweet.

• persimmon (noun)
Bangla Meaning: খেজুর।

• প্রশ্নে উল্লিখিত বাক্যটি একটি Quasi-passive sentence.
- যে sentence গঠনে active কিন্তু অর্থে passive বা অন্যের দ্বারা সংঘটিত হয় এমন বোঝায়, তাকে Quasi-passive sentence বলে।
- এই ধরনের sentence কে দুই ভাবে passive করা যায়। যেমন: 

1) Active voice এর subject টিই passive voice এর subject হিসাবে বসে + tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে + adjective টি বসে + when + প্রথম subject অনুযায়ী if/they বসে + আবারো tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb + মূল verb এর past participle.

Active: A perfectly ripe mango tastes sweet.
Passive: A perfectly ripe mango is sweet when it is tasted sweet.

2) Active এর subject টিই passive voice এর subject হিসাবে বসে + tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে + মূল verb এর past participle + adjective টি বসে।

Active: A perfectly ripe mango tastes sweet.
Passive: A perfectly ripe mango is tasted sweet.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৪) What is the correct indirect speech of the sentence: Murubbi, the saint, said to his followers, "Ugh! What's that, brother?"
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: Murubbi, the saint, angrily said to his followers that he doesn't know what that was.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: Murubbi, the saint, exclaimed in disgust and asked his followers what that was.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Murubbi, the saint, asked his followers what was happening there.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Murubbi, the saint, told his followers that he was surprised to see something.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Direct Speech: Murubbi, the saint, said to his followers, "Ugh! What's that, brother?"
• Indirect Speech: Murubbi, the saint, exclaimed in disgust and asked his followers what that was.

• Exclamatory sentence এর ক্ষেত্রে, direct speech থেকে indirect speech:
- Direct speech দ্বারা বিরক্তি বুঝালে Reporting verb পরিবর্তিত হয়ে "exclaimed with annoyance/exclaimed with joy/exclaimed with disgust"; আনন্দ বুঝালে "exclaimed with joy" এবং দুঃখ বুঝালে "exclaimed/exclaimed with sorrow/ grief" হয়।
- Inverted comma উঠে that বসবে।
- reported speech এর Subject বসে।
- Reporting verb অনুযায়ী reported speech এর verb বসবে।
- very/great বসবে।
- adjective বসবে।
- বাকি অংশ (যদি থাকে)।
- উল্লেখ্য যে, Indirect speech- এ addressing as brother কথাটি ঊহ্য রয়েছে।

এছাড়াও,
• ugh (exclamation)
English Meaning: used to express a strong feeling of disgust (= disapproval and dislike) at something very unpleasant.
Bangla Meaning: ঘৃণাসূচক অব্যয়; অ্যাহ্!

Example Sentence:
1. Ugh, I think I stepped in something really gross.
2. Ugh, I'm not eating that!

Source: 
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৫) One should keep one's promise. (Make it passive)
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option1: One's promise has to be kept.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option2: A promise should be kept by one's.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: One's promise should be kept by us.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Active Voice: One should keep one's promise.
• Passive Voice: A promise should be kept.

• One + should যুক্ত sentence - কে passive করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Active voice এর object টির subject রূপে বসবে।
- should be বসবে।
- মূল verb এর past participle বসবে।
- passive voice- এ by + one ঊহ্য রয়েছে।
- মূল passive voice হচ্ছে - One's promise should be kept by one.
- যাকে সংক্ষিপ্তভাবে "A promise should be kept." আকারে প্রকাশ করা হয়েছে।

• Structure:
- প্রথমে object টির subjective রূপ হবে + should be + মূল verb এর past participle.
